index 66e3cc1..a2beaa6 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -99,8 +99,42 @@ jobs:
       - name: Verify Knowledge Wiki package archive
         run: cargo package -p k-wiki --locked --no-verify --config 'patch.crates-io.codebase-graph.path="."'
 
+  native_retention:
+    name: native artifact retention
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    outputs:
+      retain: ${{ steps.decision.outputs.retain }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Select native artifact retention
+        id: decision
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          : "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:?}" "${GITHUB_REF:?}" "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:?}" "${GITHUB_EVENT_PATH:?}" "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?}"
+          retain="$(jq -r \
+            --arg event "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" \
+            --arg ref "$GITHUB_REF" \
+            --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" '
+            if type != "object" then error("Expected an event object")
+            elif $event == "push" then $ref == "refs/heads/main"
+            elif $event == "pull_request" then
+              ((.action == "opened" or .action == "synchronize" or
+                .action == "reopened" or .action == "edited") and
+               .pull_request.head.repo.full_name == $repository and
+               .pull_request.base.repo.full_name == $repository and
+               .pull_request.head.ref == "cod103-stack/cod-107" and
+               (.pull_request.base.ref == "cod103-stack/cod-56" or
+                .pull_request.base.ref == "main"))
+            else false
+            end' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")"
+          case "$retain" in
+            true|false) printf 'retain=%s\n' "$retain" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;;
+            *) echo 'Invalid native retention result' >&2; exit 1 ;;
+          esac
+
   native:
     name: native (${{ matrix.target }})
+    needs: [native_retention]
     strategy:
       fail-fast: false
       matrix:
@@ -114,7 +148,7 @@ jobs:
       target: ${{ matrix.target }}
       source-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
       run-tests: ${{ matrix.run-tests }}
-      upload-artifact: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
+      upload-artifact: ${{ fromJSON(needs.native_retention.outputs.retain) }}
       artifact-retention-days: 90
 
   required:
@@ -126,6 +160,7 @@ jobs:
       - supply-chain
       - publish-dry-run
       - native
+      - native_retention
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     timeout-minutes: 5
     steps:
